summary: Phase 1 SinoTrack GPS toggle plumbing verified end-to-end at the backend layer (9/9 new pytest cases pass) plus prior demo-tenant regression (27/28 pass, 1 pre-existing skip). Frontend: create-tenant-gps-enabled checkbox is present and correctly labelled on the Command Centre 'Create New Client' form (both Real + Demo modes share the same form, verified via UI screenshot). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG FOUND: the GPS Settings button (data-testid=gps-settings-btn) on the tenant dashboard is UNREACHABLE via the UI — it is rendered only inside the block `activeTab === 'vehicles' || (activeTab === 'fleet' && activeSubTab === 'vehicles')`, but the Fleet tab's subTabs config (TenantDashboard.js:691-695) exposes only 'live-fleet', 'car-calendars', 'all-cars' — there is no 'vehicles' sub-tab, and nothing sets activeTab='vehicles'. Master admin therefore cannot open the GPS Settings modal from the UI, so the modal testids (gps-settings-modal, gps-enabled-checkbox, gps-advanced-settings, gps-speed-limit, gps-poll-interval, gps-history-days, gps-device-password, gps-settings-save) could not be exercised interactively, though the JSX itself in GpsSettingsModal.js is syntactically correct and carries every testid required by the spec. The Bookings page Live Map conditional logic (Bookings.js:46, 72-85, 1310-1312, 1361) is code-correct.

ui_bugs.issue: GPS Settings button (data-testid=gps-settings-btn) is rendered inside the 'vehicles' sub-tab conditional, but the Fleet tab config (lines 691-695) never registers a 'vehicles' sub-tab. Result: the entire GPS toggle UI (modal + all sub-testids) is DEAD CODE from the master admin's perspective — no navigation path reaches activeSubTab='vehicles'. Fix options: (a) add {id:'vehicles', label:'Manage Vehicles'} to the Fleet subTabs array so users can click into it, or (b) move the GPS button into the header of the 'live-fleet' sub-tab (Fleet > Live Status) where the Fleet Vehicles listing already lives.

action_items: HIGH: expose the GPS Settings button on a navigable dashboard surface (either add a 'Manage Vehicles' Fleet sub-tab, or relocate the button into the Live Status sub-tab's header). Currently master admin cannot open the modal from the UI.

Optional: after fix, run the end-to-end UI test (create tenant with gps_enabled=true → login as master admin → open modal → toggle → Bookings/Live Map appear/disappear). Backend chain is proven; only the UI entry point is blocked.

rca of the issue: GpsSettingsModal.js and the button JSX in TenantDashboard.js are both implemented per spec (all data-testid attributes present, correct enable/disable/save behaviour). The bug is purely a wiring issue in TenantDashboard.js: the tabs config at lines 691-695 registers Fleet subTabs as ['live-fleet','car-calendars','all-cars'], but the Fleet Vehicles block that hosts the GPS button (line 1583) requires activeSubTab==='vehicles' (or top-level activeTab==='vehicles'). No code path assigns either value, so the render branch is unreachable. Reproduction: log in as master admin, open Fleet tab → sub-tabs shown are Live Status / Car Calendars / All Cars Calendar — GPS button never renders. Mitigation: add {id:'vehicles', label:'Manage Vehicles'} to the Fleet.subTabs array in TenantDashboard.js (~line 691) — one-line fix that exposes the existing Vehicles block.
